body:
## What it does

Aimed at solo builders who have to sell the thing they just shipped. On its own timetable it delivers finished social posts written to read like a person talking instead of a language model, and it pays attention to how many people opened each one before deciding which angle to try next. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @zheng_yunh2429 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
